Olivia: Postmortem follow-up INC-2026-099 -> action items for alert tuning: noise pruning, threshold retunes, dedupe, paging policy. Collating owners here.
AlertBot: Incident INC-2026-099 resolved by autoscaling at 2026-04-05T01:12:34Z. Postmortem: /incidents/INC-2026-099.
Sam: I'll own the dedupe/suppression work. Plan: 14d dry-run + false-suppression matrix. ETA: Tue EOD.
Rory: I'll handle thresholds and the 24h canary dashboard. Need p95/p99 for the last 60 days. Will post queries tomorrow AM.
Olivia: Paging owner? We want to reduce overnight wakeups. Proposal: route low-action alerts to "low-touch" 23:00-07:00 and add 12m coalesce for repeated identical alerts.
Sam: Draft suppression rule (dry-run):
```
# suppress repeated DB connection errors per host
if count(error: "db_conn_failed", host) > 8/min then suppress 40m
```
Sam: I'll run the dry-run and attach results here. Expect ~10/day suppressed if safe.
Rory: Threshold plan:
- compute rolling 30/60d p95/p99 for `service.latency_ms` and `request_error_rate`
- propose thresholds where p99 > 2x baseline or p95 > 800ms
I'll post SQL + charts by 09:30 PT.
Olivia: Owners: dedupe = Sam, thresholds = Rory, paging/rota = Olivia. Target: PRs open by 2026-04-09, rollout the week after. Tag PRs with `pm-followup/INC-2026-099`.
Rory: Also prototyping a recurrence detector: flag alerts with >5 recurrences in 30d and pattern_score >0.6. If flagged, prefer long-term fix over suppression.
Sam: If recurrence detector is live, I'll use it to filter suppression candidates to avoid masking recurring systemic issues.
Olivia: Sequence: 1) Sam: dedupe dry-run + PR (Tue EOD) 2) Rory: threshold analysis + canary dashboards (tomorrow 09:30 PT) 3) Olivia: paging config & rota updates (Fri) 4) Olivia: consolidate rollout doc + rollback plan and schedule 15m sync after rollout.
Rory: Adding rollback guard: if overall alert volume increases >12% in 24h, auto-revert changes. Will add to canary.
Sam: Draft PR branch `suppress-dedupe-099` created, will add dry-run artifacts.
Olivia: Please react with :white_check_mark: when PRs are created so I can tick items in the tracker. If anyone hits perms/data blockers, flag here.
Rory: 44d posting SQL graphs at 09:20 PT.
Sam: 44d posted dry-run results in PR; suppression seems safe for the candidates listed.
AlertBot: Reminder scheduled: followup-sync (INC-2026-099) on 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z.
Olivia: Thanks team, will update the tracker once PRs are up and send calendar invite for the sync.
